run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T07:58:43Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is backed by that service's own error spans: its ingress and 'router frontend egress' spans carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR, and the cumulative error-span counter for frontend-proxy rose from 501 at the 08:00 sample to 861 at 08:09 after being flat at 494-501 from 07:40 to 08:00 (7c7af87e-3ae8-4764-a4ad-f43f48bb8ba1-t0). The failing traffic is the checkout path only: frontend-proxy access logs show 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' proxied to frontend (0d8e2202-106e-49ca-af42-904cb11ed599-t1), and frontend's error spans in the window ending 08:10Z are confined to POST /api/checkout, its api route and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (342.12 each) while cart, product-catalog, recommendation and ad call operations stayed at 0 (ee598e97-8fc4-4ea0-9f6a-4ba185e67eb1-t0). The evidence points to the checkout Deployment in otel-demo: at 07:58:50-07:59:00Z it rolled out ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 (revision 2) whose pod-template image is 'quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0', an invalid reference containing a newline, while the previous ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) was scaled to 0 (7c7af87e-3ae8-4764-a4ad-f43f48bb8ba1-t1, e457bb60-b189-4935-934a-929088874f73-t0, e457bb60-b189-4935-934a-929088874f73-t1). The kubelet rejects that image with InvalidImageName, so the only checkout pod stays Pending and not ready (80329af2-7f54-40d2-9961-d022b2983c38-t0) and the checkout Service exposes only a notReadyAddresses entry, with no ready backend on port 8080 (e457bb60-b189-4935-934a-929088874f73-t3). All other otel-demo deployments were 1/1 ready (6cee425d-fde4-416f-ae06-fdd5a40b0a0b-t1), and the frontend and frontend-proxy pods were Running/Ready with 0 restarts (6cee425d-fde4-416f-ae06-fdd5a40b0a0b-t2), so the proxy's error rate is not a proxy or frontend pod failure, and the flagd fault-injection flags were all 'off' (fd059f10-b192-406c-a19d-0b547ac52ba7-t0). A smaller pre-existing 503 error background on the same proxy operations is distinct in signature and predates the burst. The alert rule definition and the frontend-side log text could not be read (gaps).

claims.text: frontend-proxy emitted error spans on both of its operations: increase over the hour ending 08:19:39Z was 373.55 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on span_name=ingress (vs 20726.63 STATUS_CODE_UNSET) and 364.39 on span_name='router frontend egress' (vs 20734.77 STATUS_CODE_UNSET).

The cumulative STATUS_CODE_ERROR counter for frontend-proxy ingress was 494 at the 07:40 sample, stayed between 494 and 501 through the 08:00:00 sample, then rose every minute to 861 at the 08:09:00 sample; the 'router frontend egress' counter rose from 467 to 825 over the same minutes, which is the error burst the alert reflects.

frontend's own error spans in the 600s window ending 08:10Z are confined to the checkout path: POST /api/checkout = 342.12, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout = 342.12 and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder = 342.12, while GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, AdService/GetAds and ProductCatalogService/GetProduct were all 0.

frontend-proxy access logs record the failing requests as 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' served by upstream frontend (lines at 08:04:45.094618Z through 08:04:59.540928Z); 199 such checkout-5xx lines matched between 08:00 and 08:05.

The checkout Deployment in otel-demo carries the invalid pod-template image 'quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0' and reports 1 desired replica with no readyReplicas, unavailable=1, and condition Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable; its ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (revision 1, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) was scaled to 0 while checkout-d75b77f99 (revision 2, the invalid image) was scaled to 1 during the 07:58:50-07:59:00Z rollout.

Pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 is Pending with container 'checkout' waiting under reason InvalidImageName, message: Failed to apply default image tag "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": couldn't parse image name "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": invalid reference format; it was created at 2026-11-17T07:59:00Z and its Ready condition is False with reason ContainersNotReady.

The checkout Service has no ready endpoints: its single endpoints subset contains only notReadyAddresses 100.96.4.211 for pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68, whereas every other otel-demo service entry in the same result has a ready address.

The other 20 otel-demo deployments each reported 1 desired, 1 ready and 1 available replica with no unavailable replicas at query time; only checkout reported unavailable=1, so this is not a cluster-wide scheduling or capacity shortage and the other services were checked and found ready.

The frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589 (container started 07:20:48Z) and the frontend-proxy pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-t9gll (container started 07:20:50Z) were both Running with Ready=True, restartCount 0 and no previous container instance, owned by ReplicaSets frontend-675fd7b5c5 and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985 respectively.

flagd fault-injection flags are not the cause: all 12 flags read from ConfigMap flagd-config in otel-demo (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) have state ENABLED with defaultVariant 'off' and no targeting, so no flag-declared fault is active.

A smaller, differently shaped error background exists on frontend-proxy before the burst: the ingress error counter was already 494 when data starts at 07:40 and rose only to 501 by 08:00, and sampled error traces from 07:39:19-07:46:16 show ingress status 503 with egress status error=true, http.status_code=0 (upstream connection failure), unlike the 500 'via_upstream' checkout responses of the 08:00-08:09 burst.

Mechanism: because the checkout Service has no ready address, frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder calls cannot reach a serving backend (frontend tcp.connect error spans are consistent with failed connections), the /api/checkout route answers 500, and frontend-proxy records those requests as error spans, which drives RequestErrorRate. The exact gRPC status text could not be read because the frontend container yielded no readable log lines.

Correct the container image reference in the checkout Deployment's pod template (the 'quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0' value with the embedded newline should be replaced with a valid image reference, e.g. restoring ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) so a checkout pod can start and register a ready endpoint on port 8080.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule definition could not be read: the list_prometheus_rules query for rule_name RequestErrorRate returned status no_data (6cee425d-fde4-416f-ae06-fdd5a40b0a0b-t0:a094de38-42d2-473b-909e-0de4b22c522b), so the rule's exact expression and error-ratio denominator are unknown.

No frontend application log lines were readable in the window: fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589 returned status no_data with 0 lines read (ee598e97-8fc4-4ea0-9f6a-4ba185e67eb1-t1:40560fce-30c1-49f4-aa00-9499a9cc4196, fd059f10-b192-406c-a19d-0b547ac52ba7-t1:7595d6c8-abd3-42d4-9576-8f0f889d6180), so the checkout handler's own error text and the gRPC status of PlaceOrder remain unverified.

No trace was returned for service frontend with tag error=true in 07:59-08:12 (bc801f0c-9ae6-4424-9ea2-cfef39cb5b8a-t0:3b73da28-1f5e-4a27-8fc3-babff4f1f42c) and no trace was returned for service frontend-proxy in 08:00-08:19:39 (b8c96d80-ac16-421a-b10f-779f065bbf7c-t2:82bf5451-c307-4699-b472-d950568c9e9d), so span-level detail of the 08:00-08:09 checkout failures is unavailable.

NetworkPolicies in otel-demo returned no objects (ee598e97-8fc4-4ea0-9f6a-4ba185e67eb1-t3:b40e8a46-af48-4917-8413-de922c1b264e) and the ResourceQuota object list matched nothing (7c7af87e-3ae8-4764-a4ad-f43f48bb8ba1-t2:6eeca786-581f-48ea-b2fb-33f76606e588); neither check rules in a misconfiguration, it only shows those queries matched nothing.
The source or author of the checkout Deployment image change could not be identified: the change_history integration is not available in this Run, and no event names who applied revision 2.

A metrics query for load-generator span names POST/GET returned no series (0d8e2202-106e-49ca-af42-904cb11ed599-t0:e16194d3-1e9b-41ea-8620-74e16e321e7d), so the load-generator side of the failing checkout requests was not measured.
The pre-existing 503 / http.status_code=0 egress error background on frontend-proxy before 08:00 was observed but its cause was not investigated further.
next_steps: Read the RequestErrorRate rule definition in the Prometheus/Alertmanager config to confirm the error-ratio expression and evaluation window.
Inspect the checkout Deployment's Helm values or release history (change_history integration) to identify what introduced the image value containing a newline.
After the image is corrected, confirm the checkout pod becomes Ready, the checkout Service gains a ready address, and the frontend-proxy ingress error counter stops increasing.
